what: When you hover a big circle button, the cursor disappears and in its place a badge (a rotating text ring + a finger icon) turns on within .1s, following by 50% of the remaining distance every frame. On leave, or when a pressed hand is released, it turns off within .1s, and on the next hover it follows again from its last position.

options.follow: Ratio of following each Frame (0~1), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=badge]: Badge shown in place of the cursor (size and art up to the user). Moved to body when attached

use: PAGE TOP…
note: In the original, the badge flies in from the top-left of the screen (0,0) on the first hover (the follow start position is not set) — the part starts at the cursor position

from.where: shared.js PAGE TOP big circle (.gotoTop — original main.bundle gotoTop: on mouseenter adds -enter to #js-gotoTopCursor, follows via ticker by 1 − (1 − .5)^deltaRatio each step, css transition all .1s, link cursor: none)
